headline: Quiet Saturday after a busy week
body: No scored events today. Earlier announcements faded slightly, moving a few endings by a hundredth of a point. Horizon Balance reads -5.04. After GPT-6 Astra and the Hugging Face deal, Enslaved God leads at 43.30, with Conquerors at 28.28.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; only fading earlier events, at 0.01 each.
